events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday, known for his work with Monty Python and Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: Cleese Birthday Angle
angles.copy: From the Ministry of Silly Walks to Basil Fawlty, John Cleese has given us some of the most memorable comedy moments in British history. Happy 87th to a true legend.

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" released in 1968
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled "The Beatles" but commonly known as the "White Album."

angles.name: White Album Anniversary Angle
angles.copy: Double album, double the genius. The Beatles' "White Album" dropped on this day in '68, changing music forever. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year. His incredible voice and stage presence remain legendary.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute Angle
angles.copy: Gone but never forgotten. Today we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice continues to electrify generations. A true rock icon.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" released in 1965
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their sixth studio album, "Rubber Soul," often cited as a pivotal moment in their artistic development.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary Angle
angles.copy: A landmark album that stretched the boundaries of pop. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived on this day in '65. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year. His legacy of peace and groundbreaking music lives on.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute Angle
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... living life in peace. Remembering John Lennon, a visionary artist whose message continues to resonate today.

events.title: Remembering David Bowie on his birthday
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary David Bowie, a true innovator whose influence on music, fashion, and culture is immeasurable.

angles.name: David Bowie Birthday Tribute Angle
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the Starman. David Bowie would have turned 80 today, and his artistic brilliance continues to inspire. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley on his birthday
events.blurb: Today would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, whose groundbreaking music and iconic performances changed the world.

angles.name: Elvis Presley Birthday Tribute Angle
angles.copy: Long live the King. Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, forever etched in music history. Thank you, thank you very much.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today, known for his innovative riffs and iconic solos.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Happy 83rd to the guitar god, Jimmy Page! The man behind some of rock's most iconic riffs. What's your ultimate Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today, with a career spanning over six decades of rock and pop hits.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Forever young! Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart. Cheers to a legend with a voice like no other.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham "Suggs" McPherson, the charismatic frontman of British band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday Angle
angles.copy: One step beyond! Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic voice of Madness. What's your favourite nutty tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The soulful voice behind 80s hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)," Paul Young, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Every time you go away... we miss that voice! Happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Paul Young. Still sounding fantastic!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary singer-songwriter, actress, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today, a true icon of country and pop music.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Pour yourself a cup of ambition! Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton. A national treasure and a global superstar.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer, songwriter, and television personality Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Never forget where you've been, never lose sight of where you're going. Happy 56th to the brilliant Gary Barlow! Still got that magic touch.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of international R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday Angle
angles.copy: When the going gets tough, the tough get celebrating! Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean. Still got that Caribbean Queen vibe.

events.title: First Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held in New York City, honouring pioneers like Chuck Berry, James Brown, Elvis Presley, and The Beatles.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame Anniversary Angle
angles.copy: A historic day for music! The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame opened its doors to legends on this day in '89. Which artist would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, known for his distinctive vocals and solo career, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday Angle
angles.copy: He's still got that boyband charm! Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen. What's your favourite Mark moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Iconic Rooftop Concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London, immortalised in film.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Concert Angle
angles.copy: Let it be... live! On this day in '69, The Beatles climbed onto a rooftop and made history. An unforgettable moment in music.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The acclaimed Genesis drummer and hugely successful solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Another day in paradise for Phil Collins! Happy 76th birthday to the legendary musician. What's your go-to Phil track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday Angle
angles.copy: He's bringing sexy back, and another year older! Happy 46th birthday to the incredible Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite JT hit?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: British acting legend Sir David Jason, beloved for his roles as Del Boy Trotter in Only Fools and Horses and Detective Inspector Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason. A true icon of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died (1959)
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll legends Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event later immortalized as "The Day The Music Died."

angles.name: Day The Music Died Angle
angles.copy: A tragic day that changed music forever. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, whose stars burned brightly but too briefly.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s smash hit "Never Gonna Give You Up" and his enduring career, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday Angle
angles.copy: He's never gonna give you up, never gonna let you down! Happy 61st birthday to the internet's favourite pop icon, Rick Astley.

events.title: Remembering Bob Marley on his birthday
events.blurb: Today would have been the 82nd birthday of the reggae legend Bob Marley, whose music continues to spread messages of love, peace, and unity worldwide.

angles.name: Bob Marley Birthday Tribute Angle
angles.copy: One love, one heart. Celebrating the life and enduring message of Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His music lives on.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Grammy-winning American singer-songwriter and musician Carole King, known for her prolific songwriting and iconic album "Tapestry," celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday Angle
angles.copy: You've got a friend in music! Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King, a songwriting legend whose work has shaped generations.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the passing of the legendary Whitney Houston, who would have been 64 this year. Her unparalleled voice and powerful performances continue to move millions.

angles.name: Whitney Houston Tribute Angle
angles.copy: And I... will always love you. Remembering 'The Voice', Whitney Houston, on the anniversary of her passing. Her music remains timeless.
